svg.title: One model, two instruments
svg.desc: A notebook diagram in two panels. Left panel: Intelligence Index v4.3.2, readings to 26 Oct, ten evaluations in four weighted categories, with the composite reading 55 and the three evaluations dropped in v5 named underneath. Right panel: Intelligence Index v5.0, from 27 Oct, nine evaluations in four categories, with the composite reading 46 and the three evaluations new in v5 named underneath. The two readings are joined by a dashed line labelled 'different instrument - not a comparison'. A note at the bottom describes the Progress Index v1 as the publisher's separate cross-time scale. Footer: readings taken from two page captures; no evaluation was re-run.
